metadata.case_name: TENG WEI YAN v. KWOK KAI WING AND OTHERS

injuries.description: Multiple fractured ribs (5th-8th) on the left side with hemo-pneumothorax / left pneumothorax
source: X-rays of her chest and pelvis showed multiple fractured ribs on the left posterior side, with left pneumothorax.
abrasion over the forehead and chin, fractured ribs (5th-8th) on the left side with hemo-pneumothorax, and a fracture of the right clavicle.
abrasion over the forehead and chin, fractured ribs (5th-8th) on the left side with hemo-pneumothorax, and a fracture of the right clavicle.

injuries.description: Ruptured spleen resulting in hemoperitoneum and splenectomy (emergency laparotomy performed)
source: An emergency laparotomy was also performed, which revealed hemoperitoneum due to a ruptured spleen. A splenectomy was performed.
After the operation, the Plaintiff’s condition was complicated with pneumonia. Bronchoscopy was done on 18 June 2002 and she was prescribed with antibiotics treatment.

injuries.description: Abrasion over the forehead and chin; bruise and swelling on the left leg
source: physical examinations at the Accident & Emergency Department of CMC revealed that the Plaintiff had pain and tenderness on the right shoulder and left posterior chest, and bruise and swelling on the left leg.
she was found to have abrasion over the forehead and chin

injuries.description: Midline vertical abdominal scar (255mm) and two smaller scars (24mm each) including an oblique scar near the left 7th rib (scarring / disfigurement)
injuries.body_part: abdomen / lower abdomen / left 7th rib area
source: there is a midline vertical scar from the Plaintiff’s xiphisternum to her lower abdomen measuring 255mm long and 8mm at its widest part. The scar is partly raised and partly flat, thin, soft and irregularly pigmented. There are 2 smaller scars: one on the lower left side of the abdomen measuring 24mm, and one oblique scar 24mm long and 1mm wide near the left 7th rib which is flat, thin, soft and pale.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: pain and tenderness on the right shoulder
pain and tenderness on the left posterior chest / residual pain in the left chest wall
bruise and swelling on the left leg
pain around the scar over the abdomen / residual abdominal pain around the scar
irregular and infrequent menstruation after the injury / irregular menstrual pains
right shoulder pain triggered by carrying heavy objects with the right hand

treatments_future: Cosmetic/plastic treatment for abdominal and other scars (as recommended by Dr. Chow Sik Kuen; cost HK$20,100 agreed)

losses.description: The scar on her abdomen which apparently made her very self-conscious; youthful and single plaintiff has suffered and will suffer some impairment as a result of the scars.
Residual pain over the left lower chest and right shoulder with small permanent impairments awarded (rib fractures and clavicle fracture).
